title: Rural Home Loans Nonaccrual and Return to Accrual
content:
**Rule.** A Rural Home Loans loan in active status is placed in nonaccrual when a monthly payment remains not paid in full more than the product's nonaccrual threshold of calendar days after its due date, the due date being day 0; payments continue to be applied, late charges stop, and no recast, escrow waiver or mortgage insurance cancellation on request is available. The loan returns to active status on the day every past-due monthly payment is paid in full. A loan in forbearance is not placed in nonaccrual for forborne months.

## Counting the threshold (hypothetical 90-day threshold)

| Day counted from the due date (due date is day 0) | Payment still not paid in full |
|---|---|
| day 90 | not yet placed in nonaccrual |
| day 91 | placed in nonaccrual |

## While in nonaccrual

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Payments | continue to be applied |
| Late charges | stop |
| Recast | not available |
| Escrow waiver | not available |
| Mortgage insurance cancellation on request | not available |

## Return to accrual

The loan returns to active status on the day every past-due monthly payment is paid in full — not on the day the oldest one alone is paid while another remains past due.
